newsitem.title: USA: C. H. Robinson files for initial public offering.
newsitem.headline: C. H. Robinson files for initial public offering.

text.p: C. H. Robinson Worldwide Inc said Monday it has registered with the Securities and Exchange Commission a proposed initial public offering of 10,578,396 shares of its common stock.

The shares represent about 25 percent of the company's outstanding stock. All of the stock is being sold by existing shareholders of the company, all of whom are current or former company employees. The company will not receive any of the proceeds of the offering.

Founded in 1905, C. H. Robinson provides multimodal transportation and logistics services through a network of 116 offices in 38 states, Canada, Mexico, Belgium, the United Kingdom, France, Spain, Italy, Singapore, and South Africa. It had 1996 gross revenues of $1.6 billion.

C.H. Robinson estimates the initial offering price will be between $15 and $17 per share. The offering is expected to be made in September through underwriters led by Alex. Brown & Sons Inc, Morgan Stanley Dean Witter, and Piper Jaffray Inc.
